 THIS MFA FILED U/S.173(1) OF MV ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DT.19.11.2020 PASSED IN MVC NO.305/2019 ON THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE, MACT, CHIKKAMAGALURU, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 19.11.2020 passed in MVC No.305/2019 by the Court of II Addl.
Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Chikkamagaluru (for short 'the Tribunal'), the petitioner therein has preferred this appeal.
2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to herein as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. Brief facts of the case are as follows:

2
On 16.06.2019 at about 7.00 am.
the petitioner was proceeding in his motor cycle bearing registration No.KA- 18/EA-9046 along with a pillion rider from Javagal to Sankihalli.

When he reached near Malladevihalli Gate, Javagal Hobli, Arsikere Taluk,
Hassan District, a Hyundai Creta car bearing registration No.KL-17/S-90 being driven in a rash and negligent manner and duly insured with respondent No.3-insurance company came and dashed against the said motor cycle.
Because of which, petitioner sustained the fracture of humerus bone.

4. The Tribunal, based on the evidence let in, has awarded a compensation of 62,469/- along with interest @ 8% p.a. from the date of petition till realization under the following heads:-
Towards expenses relating to treatment 1. Rs.1,882/-
and hospitalization and medicines Towards nourishment diet, food and 2. Rs.4,000/-
attendant
charges
3. Towards pain and suffering Rs.10,000/-

4. Towards conveyance charges Rs.5,000/-
5. Towards amenities Rs.10,000/-
Towards loss of income during laid up 6. Rs.2,000/-
period 7.

For injuries Rs.10,000/-
8.

Vehicle repair bill Rs.19,587/-
TOTAL Rs.62,469/-
Not satisfied by the same, the petitioner has preferred this appeal.

5. After arguing the matter for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as respondent No.3- insurance company together submit that the compensation awarded may be enhanced to Rs.1,24,000/- as against Rs.62,469/- granted by the Tribunal.

It is also submitted that interest at Mohammad Azar vs Sibi Thomas on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174551427/
3 the rate of 6% p.a. may be awarded on the enhanced compensation.
6. In my opinion, given the facts and circumstances of the case, submission of learned counsel for the petitioner and respondent No.3-insurance company is just and fair.

SD/-
